product.title: Yellow Silk Kurta, Multi-Tone Chevron & Embroidered Bandi Jacket & Cream Aligarhi for Men
product.vendor: AROK - N M FASHION DESIGNS PVT LTD

description.html:
Product Description
Redefine your festive presence with this Sunburst Yellow Silk Set. Crafted from rich, premium silk fabric, this refined outfit features a long, above-knee cream-yellow kurta, classic cream silk Aligarhi-style bottoms, and a statement Bandi jacket showcasing energetic chevron and Leheriya stripes in yellow, turquoise, and coral. Accentuated with delicate white floral embroidery framing the jacket border, a sharp Bandgala collar with multi-tone stitch detailing, and contrasting pink buttons along the kurta placket, this ensemble strikes a flawless balance between celebratory color and modern tailoring. Whether attending haldi ceremonies, daytime pujas, or festive family gatherings, this outfit guarantees a vibrant, royal presence.

Key Features
3-Piece Complete Set
Premium Silk Fabric with Cream Silk Aligarhi Bottoms
Yellow, Turquoise & Coral Leheriya Print
Floral Thread Embroidery
Classic Bandhgala Collar with Multi-Color Stitching
Contrast Pink Button Detailing
Ideal for Haldi, Daytime Functions & Festive Celebrations

Styling Tips
Footwear: Complete your look by pairing this ensemble with our Handcrafted Embroidered Juttis for a traditional aesthetic, or our Classic Leather Sandals for a sleek, breathable finish.

Accessories: Enhance the look with an antique gold or silver-toned watch, regal metallic cuff studs, and a statement ring featuring traditional stone setting to complement the fine threadwork.

Styling: Wear the full 3-piece set for main daytime ceremonies and haldi festivities, or pair the cream-yellow kurta and cream Aligarhi bottoms solo for a light, effortless celebration look.
